status: reference artwork and implementation source; production 3D meshes not included
dimension_convention: Item dimensions: local Blender X width, Y depth, Z height/drop. Layout uses game X right, Y up, Z forward.

items.title: Straight aerial deck
items.origin: Center of the upper driving deck, Z=0; travel along local -Y.
items.workflow: Blender: build a dimensioned repeatable mesh or sweep a cross-section along the route.
items.collision: Simple deck slab; keep bolts and decorative underbody non-colliding.
items.construction_note: 18 m usable width, 24 m nominal length, 2 m structure below the deck. The source image gives panel and lighting style; its apparent proportions do not define meter scale. Join positions and tangent continuity come from Layout/route.json.
items.dimensions_order: Local Blender X width, Y depth, Z height, meters; not a game-coordinate tuple.
items.provenance: Reused unchanged from the approved Neon Circuit B course asset collection.

items.title: Curved aerial deck
items.origin: Centerline at the entrance on the deck surface; local -Y is the entrance tangent.
items.workflow: Blender: generate from a curve with a shared cross-section.
items.collision: Simplified curved deck strip; separate outer curb collision.
items.construction_note: 18 m usable width; initial center radius 64 m and 30 degree turn as an authoring target. Match the actual route curvature instead of forcing this radius everywhere. Share seam vertices or snap matching boundary loops.
items.dimensions_order: Local Blender X width, Y depth, Z height, meters; not a game-coordinate tuple.
items.provenance: Reused unchanged from the approved Neon Circuit B course asset collection.

items.title: Climbing transition ramp
items.origin: Center of lower entrance on the upper deck surface, Z=0; travel local -Y.
items.workflow: Blender: control both end heights and tangents; generate an eased climb profile.
items.collision: Low-poly sloped deck with eased transitions, never a full bounding box across the air space.
items.construction_note: Nominal 24 m horizontal length, 18 m width, 6 m rise and about 2 m structural depth. Use longer ramps where car control needs a gentler climb. The PNG is a style reference; rebuild exact slopes from the validated centerline.
items.dimensions_order: Local Blender X width, Y depth, Z height, meters; not a game-coordinate tuple.
items.provenance: Generated for these map packs with the built-in image generator; transparent background enabled.

items.title: Checkpoint ring

items.workflow: Blender: torus or segmented extruded ring with separate emissive bands.
items.collision: Optional ring rim segments only. The opening is a trigger volume and must remain empty.
items.construction_note: 22 m clear inner diameter; 26 m approximate outer diameter. Derive gate plane position and normal from the flight path. Keep scoring trigger separate from visible geometry.
items.dimensions_order: Local Blender X width, Y depth, Z height, meters; not a game-coordinate tuple.

items.title: Start / finish arch
items.origin: Center of the clear passage at the route flight height; local -Y forward.
items.workflow: Blender: three structural beams with instanced decorative panels and a separate sign.
items.collision: Separate posts and lintel only; no collider filling the opening.
items.construction_note: Author a clear passage at least 22 m wide by 22 m high. The source includes START lettering. Rebuild its sign as runtime text or a clean decal so it can display START/FINISH and localize; do not ask Meshy to reconstruct readable lettering.
items.dimensions_order: Local Blender X width, Y depth, Z height, meters; not a game-coordinate tuple.

items.title: Deck support column

items.collision: One shaft box plus cap box, placed below/outside the flight corridor.
items.construction_note: Default target height 40 m; set individual support heights to the deck underside. Extend shaft geometry rather than stretching bolts and trim. Floating sections may omit supports.

items.construction_note: Use sparingly at hazardous turns. A barrier is scenery/collision, not a mandatory navigation gate. Regenerate chevrons cleanly in geometry or vector art if required.
